method_coverage.note: explicit = Steel struct overrides the mapped trait method; defaulted = Steel trait has a default body and the struct does not override it; unknown/client_only are excluded from the denominator and are not evidence either way.

No single behavior trait: Steel implements an entity trait hierarchy, so a global method percentage would be meaningless. Counts are reported per class in the JSON; `not_explicit` is not evidence of a gap.
